thread:
matt: Heads-up — eu-west canary is showing a 95p latency spike after the SDK/runtime mix changed. Suspect the runtime unpin from last night. Thinking we should soft-pin runtime:v3.2.1 in eu-west for a short window while we triage.
dina: Can you paste the metric lines and which model(s) are affected?

matt: Quick snippet from obs (20:10 UTC):
```
service=runtime eu-west canary | model=quant-v3b | p95=420ms (baseline 120ms) | error-rate ~0.3% | spike started ~02:08 UTC
```
Only on canary hosts (tags: canary, eu-west). Affects both streaming and non-streaming paths.

carla: If it's just canary we could route production traffic away, but a pin sounds safer if the spike correlates with the unpin. Any evidence it's the kernel change vs SDK shims?

matt: Kernel selection logs show a higher number of fallback kernels after the unpin. Not 100% root cause but high correlation. Also saw increased GC pauses in the new runtime variant on longseq workloads.

alice: What scope do we want for the pin? Full eu-west? model-group? Only canary? We should avoid broad pins during the change window unless necessary.

jon: I can run the pin if we decide. Deploy-bot supports scoped pins: by region, by runtime variant, or by model tag. Example command: `/deploy pin runtime:v3.2.1 --scope=region:eu-west --filter=tag:canary`

deploy-bot: No active pins for runtime in eu-west. To proceed run: `/deploy pin runtime:v3.2.1 --scope=region:eu-west --filter=tag:canary --expires=3h --reason="p95 latency spike post-unpin"`

sre-bot: Pre-pin checklist:
- Confirmed metric regression on canary (yes)
- Escalation channels notified (eng-runtime, eng-releases)
- Rollback runbook on hand (see snippet below)
```
If pin fails or causes regressions: 
  1) run `/deploy unpin <pin-id>`
  2) shift traffic to fallback region (eu-north) via routing-policy temporarily
  3) open P0 on PagerDuty if >1% error-rate or p95 > 1s for 10m
```

dina: +1 from SRE side. Keep it limited to canary tag, expires 3h, and we'll run a quick diff on p95 after 10m and 30m.

matt: Agreed. jon — go ahead when ready. Please post pin-id and tag the release lead.

jon: Running now: `/deploy pin runtime:v3.2.1 --scope=region:eu-west --filter=tag:canary --expires=3h --reason="p95 latency spike post-unpin"`
deploy-bot: Pin created ✅
- pin_id: pin-20260321-8247
- target: runtime:v3.2.1
- scope: region=eu-west, filter=tag:canary
- expires: 3h
- initiated_by: jon

carla: :thumbsup: I'll monitor canary dashboards for the next 30m. If p95 normalizes we can keep the pin while the runtime team builds a small patch.

matt: Thanks all. Action items:
- runtime team: investigate kernel fallback cause (matt)
- eng-releases: note pin in release notes for the window (alice)
- SRE: watch p95 & error-rate, escalate if worse (dina)

alice: Noted — I'll add a short entry to the changelog and inform the oncall rotation.

sre-bot: Monitoring alert rule applied: check eu-west canary p95; will post in 10m and 30m.

jon: Pin complete and logged. Leaving this thread open for updates / decision on extension or rollback.
